title: US school district grading policies
description: Verified grading-policy data points from US public school districts. Every entry links to the district's officially published policy and records the date we accessed it. Policies change — always confirm against the linked source.

policies.scope: State-assessed high school courses; the State end-of-course assessment serves as the final exam grade
policies.quote: the State end-of-course assessment as the final exam grade and the final exam grade will be 20% of the final grade
policies.source_name: HCPSS Policy 8020 Implementation Procedures — Grading and Reporting: Middle and High School

policies.scope: Quarterly grades: neither summative nor short-term assignment categories may exceed this share
policies.quote: Neither summative nor short-term assignment categories should exceed 70% of the total quarterly grade

policies.scope: High school semester grades: each quarter counts 37.5% and the final examination 25%
policies.source_name: Broward County Public Schools — High School Grading & Grade Point Averages

conventions.name: 40/40/20 semester split
conventions.description: A widely used (but not universal) US high-school pattern: each of two quarters counts 40% of the semester grade and the final exam counts 20%. Districts vary — see the entries above for verified examples that differ.
